text: Hydro-CPS-Sim 文档 面向供水网络信息物理系统安全研究的联合仿真平台。 Hydro-CPS-Sim 将水力过程、PLC 控制、SCADA 通信与网络仿真连接起来，为网络攻击评估、跨层影响分析和防御研究提供可扩展的实验环境。 源代码： WandeF/hydro-cps-sim 项目概览 跨层联合仿真 ：连接水力模型、控制逻辑和通信过程，观察网络层事件如何影响物理水网。 攻击影响评估 ：为 MITM、DoS 与 PLC 逻辑篡改等研究场景提供实验与分析框架；实际可执行场景以源码和配置为准。 可复现实验流程 ：以配置文件组织仿真，通过脚本启动多组件闭环，并导出运行日志与 CSV 结果。 面向研究扩展 ：围绕控制、网络和物理层扩展实验设置，用于研究攻击传播、异常检测及防御策略。 平台关注一个核心问题： 网络攻击如何通过数据采集、控制决策和执行过程，逐步传播到物理水力系统？ 典型研究链路：攻击与扰动 → 网络通信（ns-3 / Namespace）→ SCADA / PLC → 水力计算（DHALSIM-epynet）→ 日志与 CSV 分析。 文档状态： 本站是已部署的研究软件文档初版。公开源码仓库目前仍在整理中，尚未核实的配置字段、论文信息与实验结论不会在这里当作已发布事实。 文档目录 项目概览 项目简介 系统架构 使用指南 安装与环境 快速开始 实验与配置 攻防实验 配置说明 社区与研究 论文与引用 贡献与反馈

text: 项目简介 Hydro-CPS-Sim 是一个围绕**供水系统（Water Distribution Systems）**构建的 CPS 安全联合仿真研究平台，主要服务于工业网络攻击影响分析、攻击路径研究和防御方法验证。 研究动机 传统水力模拟工具擅长计算流量、压力、水箱水位等物理变量，但难以独立体现真实控制和通信过程；网络仿真工具能够刻画时延、丢包和拓扑，却往往缺少真实水力反馈。将两者在闭环中整合，可以分析攻击是否、何时以及如何影响物理系统。 项目组件 组件 在研究平台中的作用 DHALSIM-epynet / EPANET 水网水力计算及物理状态更新 OpenPLC PLC 程序执行与控制逻辑 ns-3 通信网络建模与仿真 Linux Network Namespace 将主机网络过程映射到隔离网络环境 Python 协调与分析模块 配置读取、组件编排、状态交互和实验结果导出 典型研究问题 攻击导致的数据篡改，在哪个控制轮次改变 PLC 决策？ 丢包或通信超时是否必然引起泵阀控制偏离？ 相同的物理异常，是否可能来自不同的网络和逻辑原因？ 如何将网络日志、控制轨迹和水力变量关联起来进行因果分析？ 当前边界 该项目旨在科研仿真和方法验证，不是现实供水设施的运维控制软件。不同攻击场景的可用性、参数名称和示例数据需与对应提交版本核对。任何未经过验证的实验结果不应作为真实供水系统风险的直接量化结论。 公开代码： https://github.com/WandeF/hydro-cps-sim

title: 系统架构
description: 系统架构 平台采用 多层闭环联合仿真 思路：水力状态经传感器与采集通道进入控制层，PLC 基于控制逻辑更新执行器动作，动作再反馈给水力计算模块。网络层对通信过程提供仿真环境。 逻辑分层 层级 主要模块 关注的问题 物理层 DHALSIM-epynet / EPANET 水位、压力、流量等状
text: 系统架构 平台采用 多层闭环联合仿真 思路：水力状态经传感器与采集通道进入控制层，PLC 基于控制逻辑更新执行器动作，动作再反馈给水力计算模块。网络层对通信过程提供仿真环境。 逻辑分层 层级 主要模块 关注的问题 物理层 DHALSIM-epynet / EPANET 水位、压力、流量等状态演化 控制层 OpenPLC PLC 输入、控制逻辑、执行器指令 监控层 SCADA 通信与采集 数据上报、下发和缓存 网络层 ns-3 + Linux Network Namespace 拓扑、链路状态、通信扰动 编排层 Python 运行器 配置、进程启动、同步、结果导出 一个典型闭环 读取当前水力状态与传感器变量。 将观测数据通过通信路径送入 PLC / SCADA 相关模块。 执行 PLC 控制逻辑，确定泵阀等动作。 将新的控制动作作用于水力系统，并推进仿真步。 保存日志与状态，为下一轮控制提供输入。 上述流程是对研究架构的概念性说明，具体执行顺序应以运行器源码为准。 代码入口 scripts/run_all.sh ：示例运行的总调度脚本。 src/network/ ：网络拓扑和运行环境生成相关模块。 src/control/ ：PLC 程序生成、编译和运行相关模块。 src/runtime/ ：闭环同步与运行时逻辑。 src/io/ ：实验数据导出。 详见公开仓库中的 run_all.sh 。 未来可以补充的图 正式发布前建议加入：平台总体架构图、单轮同步时序图，以及 MITM / DoS / PLC 逻辑攻击的跨层传播图。图中各箭头应明确区分数据流、控制流、网络通信和攻击影响路径。

title: 安装与环境

text: 安装与环境 这里的安装说明根据公开的 install.sh 整理。执行前建议先阅读脚本，了解其对系统软件包和第三方仓库的修改。 支持的环境 项目 已确认要求 操作系统 Ubuntu 22.04 / 24.04，x86_64 Python 3.10（安装脚本创建的 Conda 环境） 环境管理 Conda 系统权限 安装和网络配置环节需要 sudo 网络连接 安装依赖及克隆所需仓库 主体依赖 OpenPLC 命令行运行时、ns-3、DHALSIM-epynet 注意： 脚本安装的是 OpenPLC 命令行运行时，不是 Web 管理服务。请不要将本说明理解为安装完整的 OpenPLC Web 界面。 获取源码 git clone https://github.com/WandeF/hydro-cps-sim.git cd hydro-cps-sim 预检查 首先建议使用只读预演参数，查看计划执行的操作： bash install.sh --dry-run 正式安装 确认环境及权限后再运行： bash install.sh conda activate hydro-cps 安装过程中可能需要较长时间编译 OpenPLC 和 ns-3。默认环境名为 hydro-cps ；脚本也支持 --env 、 --jobs 、 --parent 等参数，详见 bash install.sh --help 。 安装完成后的自检 安装脚本末尾包含基础测试过程；如需再次运行仓库中的 Python 单元测试： python -m unittest discover -s tests 请区分两种验证 ：本站的文档构建成功不等于仿真平台安装成功。完整环境安装需要在符合条件的 Linux 计算机上单独进行。 源码核对： hydro-cps-sim @ 2406aa6 · 2026-10-15. 安装脚本会更新所有 C-Town 示例 YAML 的五个顶层路径键，并将修改前的文件保存到 output/install-backups/ 。迁移机器后需重新检查路径；不要直接沿用源码中的开发者绝对路径。

text: 快速开始 本页以仓库自带的 C-Town 示例配置为入口。以下命令来自当前公开运行脚本，建议在安装成功后执行。 每次运行会清理配置输出目录中的 runtime/ 、 reports/ 、 st/ 和 plcs/ 。开始另一个实验前，请将需要比较的结果复制到独立目录。使用普通用户启动，脚本会按需请求 sudo。 运行一个示例 cd hydro-cps-sim conda activate hydro-cps bash scripts/run_all.sh --logic-wait 0.3 如果希望先缩短实验轮数，可以使用运行器的 --iterations 参数，例如： bash scripts/run_all.sh --iterations 10 --logic-wait 0.3 这里的 10 只是用于演示运行参数的示例值，并不是已经验证的基准配置。 自定义配置入口 bash scripts/run_all.sh --config examples/c_town/config.yaml 运行器的可选参数包括： 参数 用途 --config PATH 指定 YAML 配置文件 --iterations N 覆盖仿真轮数 --logic-wait SECONDS SCADA 下发后、读取 PLC 输出前的等待间隔 --poll-interval SECONDS 文件标志轮询间隔 --scada-modbus-workers N SCADA Modbus 并行工作线程数 具体帮助信息可由 bash scripts/run_all.sh --help 查询。 查看输出 运行脚本会输出日志、时序统计等内容。根据当前公开入口，实验结果导出位置为配置所指定输出目录下的 reports/csv 。 运行结束后，终端还会打印类似下面的提示： [DONE] Results: <output_path>/reports/csv 真实路径取决于配置文件中的 output_path ，请勿直接复制上面的占位符作为命令。 下一步 请参考 攻防实验 了解如何组织基线与攻击条件对照，并在 配置说明 中核对场景文件。 源码核对： hydro-cps-sim @ 2406aa6 · 2026-10-15.

title: 攻防实验
description: 攻防实验 Hydro-CPS-Sim 的研究重点之一，是沿着 网络事件 → 数据状态 → 控制决策 → 水力响应 的链路分析攻击传播机制。 研究场景 攻击类型 网络或控制层变化 重点观测 MITM（中间人攻击） 通信内容可能遭到修改 输入数据与真实物理状态的偏差、决策变化 DoS（拒绝服务
text: 攻防实验 Hydro-CPS-Sim 的研究重点之一，是沿着 网络事件 → 数据状态 → 控制决策 → 水力响应 的链路分析攻击传播机制。 研究场景 攻击类型 网络或控制层变化 重点观测 MITM（中间人攻击） 通信内容可能遭到修改 输入数据与真实物理状态的偏差、决策变化 DoS（拒绝服务） 通信延迟、丢包或超时 数据新鲜度、缓存使用、控制时机 PLC 逻辑篡改 控制规则可能发生变化 PLC 逻辑、执行器输出、物理轨迹 源码中实际提供的配置 下表按 YAML 内容核对，窗口单位为控制轮次。仅核对了源码与配置，尚未完整运行这些仿真实验。 配置文件 目标或用途 攻击轮次 config.yaml 无攻击基线 / Baseline — config_mitm_plc4.yaml PLC4 下发 / Downlink 20–40 config_mitm_plc9.yaml PLC8 T7 响应 / Response 20–40 config_mitm_composite_plc7_plc9.yaml PLC6 T5 + PLC8 T7 20–40 / 30–50 config_dos_plc2_single.yaml PLC2 · 单源 / Single source 5–90 config_dos_plc2_three_bots.yaml PLC2 · 三源 / Three sources 5–90 config_openplc_logic_plc4.yaml PLC4 · PU10 T7 阈值 / Threshold 20–90 文件名中的 PLC7/PLC9 是历史命名；当前配置中的实际目标为 PLC6/PLC8，应读取 YAML 内容确认。旧 README_attack_mitm.md 中的 config_mitm.yaml 和 scripts/compare_attack_results.py 在该版本中不存在。 安装成功后，可在仿真环境中选择实际配置（下例为源码核对命令，未在本次部署中运行）： bash scripts/run_all.sh --config examples/c_town/config_mitm_plc4.yaml --logic-wait 0.3 先运行基线并保存结果，再运行攻击配置。导出目录 reports/csv/ 包含 physics.csv 、 actuator_state.csv 、 scada_observed_long.csv 、 scada_observed_wide.csv 、 scada_observed_key.csv 、 attack_schedule.csv 、 attack_events.csv 、 scada_timeout_events.csv 和 cycle_timing.csv 。攻击事件或超时记录并不等于已经产生物理偏离，需要与基线对齐分析。 推荐的对照流程 固定水网、PLC 逻辑、仿真时长和必要的随机性设置。 运行无攻击基线（baseline），保存每轮 CSV 与日志。 仅改变准备考察的攻击变量，运行对照实验。 对齐网络、PLC 和水力时间记录，分析关键轮次。 汇总重复实验结果，而不仅是展示单次运行曲线。 跨层分析不应只看最终水位 同样的水箱水位偏差，可能来自错误传感数据、通信超时导致的陈旧数据，或者 PLC 控制规则改变。因此需要同时收集上游证据。对于 DoS，发生通信超时并不保证会导致控制偏离，实际传播还取决于控制所需数据是否及时更新。 发布前建议补充 攻击 YAML 示例与字段表（从实际代码中逐项核对）。 基线实验和各攻击实验的一键运行命令。 数据目录约定、时间戳含义及评价指标。 可复现实验图与必要的参数、随机种子说明。 实验数据、攻击成功率和论文结论应在论文定稿及验证后补入，避免把讨论中的结论误写成已经公开复现的结果。 源码核对： hydro-cps-sim @ 2406aa6 · 2026-10-15.

title: 配置说明
description: 配置说明 当前公开运行器使用 YAML 配置文件组织实验场景，默认入口为 examples/c_town/config.yaml 。 配置文件在运行中的作用 指定水网模型及其输入文件。 指向 OpenPLC、ns-3 等组件所在目录。 指定输出目录及仿真轮数。 保存水网控制、网络及实验设置
text: 配置说明 当前公开运行器使用 YAML 配置文件组织实验场景，默认入口为 examples/c_town/config.yaml 。 配置文件在运行中的作用 指定水网模型及其输入文件。 指向 OpenPLC、ns-3 等组件所在目录。 指定输出目录及仿真轮数。 保存水网控制、网络及实验设置。 安装脚本会处理示例 YAML 中的若干路径键，源码中明确出现了： 路径键 用途 root_path 第三方依赖工作目录 openplc_path OpenPLC 源码或构建目录 ns3_path ns-3 源码或构建目录 inp_file EPANET 水网输入文件 output_path 实验结果输出目录 这些字段可在 install.sh 中核对。其他 YAML 字段需要针对当前版本的真实配置文件补全，暂不在此猜测。 建议工作方式 不要直接修改唯一的基准配置；可以复制已验证的 config.yaml ，然后在副本中改变实验参数。每次实验应记录所用源码提交、配置文件、启动命令与日志位置。 待完善内容 按模块给出完整 YAML 字段字典。 附一个可运行的 baseline 配置和一个已验证攻击配置。 解释配置与网络拓扑、PLC 映射、物理模型间的约束。 源码核对： hydro-cps-sim @ 2406aa6 · 2026-10-15. 已核对的其他字段 字段 当前基线值或作用 iterations 100；可由运行命令覆盖 noise_scale 0.0 time EPANET 总时长 86400 秒、水力步长 300 秒 physics inp_controls: strip 、 step_order: next-run 、 init_flag: 0 plcs PLC1–PLC8 的传感器、执行器与控制规则 network ns-3 后端、实时调度、路由、节点、链路、LAN 和 TAP attacks.enabled 攻击配置的总开关 attacks.scenarios 场景类型、触发器、目标和类型特有参数 攻击场景类型包括 modbus_mitm 、 udp_dos 、 openplc_logic_injection 。 trigger.type: iteration_window 使用 start_iteration / end_iteration ；场景还需对应的攻击节点、拦截规则或逻辑注入设置，不应仅向基线追加一个开关。参见 攻防实验 中的实际配置。

text: 贡献与反馈 欢迎围绕功能、安装流程和复现实验提出建议。项目开源许可和正式贡献流程需在发布计划明确后确定。 报告问题 如果遇到异常，建议通过项目的 GitHub Issues 反馈，并尽量提供： 操作系统、Python / Conda 版本。 所用 Git 提交号、配置文件（删除个人路径与敏感信息）。 重现问题的命令与关键报错。 预期结果与实际结果。 网站文档更新 本文档网站位于 WandeF/WandeF.github.io ，与软件源码分开维护。修改位于 content/zh/ 和 content/en/ 的 Markdown 文件后执行： python build.py 构建产物写入 site/ 。本地通过 python -m http.server 8000 --directory site 即可预览；推送到 main 后，GitHub Actions 自动构建并部署到 https://wandef.github.io/ 。 贡献范围 当前文档主要用于研究团队内部整理与公开发布前的预览。正式接受外部贡献前，建议补充 LICENSE 、 CONTRIBUTING.md 、版本管理规则和负责任披露说明。

title: Home
description: Hydro-CPS-Sim Documentation A co-simulation platform for water cyber-physical system security research. Hydro-CPS-Sim connects hydraulic dynamics
text: Hydro-CPS-Sim Documentation A co-simulation platform for water cyber-physical system security research. Hydro-CPS-Sim connects hydraulic dynamics, PLC control, SCADA communications, and network simulation to support attack-impact evaluation, cross-layer analysis, and defense research. Source code: WandeF/hydro-cps-sim Overview Cross-layer co-simulation : Link hydraulic models, control logic, and communication processes to study how cyber events affect the physical network. Attack-impact evaluation : Support research into MITM, DoS, and PLC logic modification scenarios. Runnable cases depend on the published code and configurations. Reproducible workflows : Organize experiments through configuration files and scripts, and export logs and CSV results for analysis. Research extensibility : Investigate control, network, and hydraulic effects within a modular experiment framework. The key research question is: How do cyberattacks propagate through sensing, control decisions, and actuation into physical water-system behavior? A typical research path: attacks and disturbances → network communication (ns-3 / Namespace) → SCADA / PLC → hydraulics (DHALSIM-epynet) → log and CSV analysis. Documentation status: This is the deployed working draft of the research software documentation. Unverified configuration keys, publication details, and experiment claims are deliberately left as follow-up work. title: Introduction
description: Introduction Hydro-CPS-Sim is a research co-simulation platform for water distribution cyber-physical systems . It is designed for security exper
text: Introduction Hydro-CPS-Sim is a research co-simulation platform for water distribution cyber-physical systems . It is designed for security experimentation, cross-layer impact assessment, and defense-method evaluation. Motivation Hydraulic simulators capture the evolution of pressures, flows, and tank levels, while network simulators characterize topology, delays, and packet loss. Studying cyber-physical incidents requires combining both aspects with an actual control loop. Main components Component Role DHALSIM-epynet / EPANET Hydraulic simulation and physical-state updates OpenPLC PLC control-program execution ns-3 Communication-network simulation Linux Network Namespace Isolated Linux network environments Python orchestration modules Configuration, process coordination, state exchange, and output Example research questions At what control iteration does manipulated input data change a PLC decision? Does packet loss or timeout necessarily cause an actuator deviation? Can similar physical anomalies arise from different cyber or control causes? How can network traces, controller behavior, and physical trajectories be aligned? Scope This is a research simulation tool, not software for operating a real water utility. Availability of specific attack configurations and parameter names must be checked against the corresponding repository version. Simulation results should not be interpreted directly as quantitative risk assessments for production systems. Repository: https://github.com/WandeF/hydro-cps-sim

title: Architecture
description: Architecture The platform follows a closed-loop, multi-layer co-simulation approach. Sensor measurements inform controller decisions; PLC outputs
text: Architecture The platform follows a closed-loop, multi-layer co-simulation approach. Sensor measurements inform controller decisions; PLC outputs affect actuators; and actuator states are fed back into the hydraulic model. Network simulation mediates communication in the cyber layer. Layers Layer Major components Focus Physical DHALSIM-epynet / EPANET Tank levels, pressures, flows Control OpenPLC PLC logic and actuator commands Supervisory SCADA communication Data acquisition, commands, and caching Network ns-3 and Linux Network Namespace Topology and communication impairment Orchestration Python scripts Configuration, synchronization, execution, export Conceptual simulation cycle Obtain the current hydraulic state and relevant sensor values. Exchange observations through the cyber/control communication path. Run the PLC control logic and compute new actuator actions. Apply the actions to the hydraulic model and advance the simulation. Save the observable evidence for subsequent analysis. The exact execution sequence is defined by the runtime implementation; the cycle above is a conceptual explanation. Source-code entry points scripts/run_all.sh : top-level example runner. src/network/ : network and topology generation. src/control/ : PLC generation, compilation, and execution. src/runtime/ : closed-loop runtime orchestration. src/io/ : experiment result export. See the published run_all.sh . Planned illustrations Before final release, add an overall architecture figure, a single-iteration sequence diagram, and attack propagation diagrams. Clearly differentiate data flow, control flow, network traffic, and attack influence.

title: Installation
description: Installation These instructions are based on the published install.sh . Review the script before running it, since it installs system packages an
text: Installation These instructions are based on the published install.sh . Review the script before running it, since it installs system packages and checks out external dependencies. Source-defined environment requirements Item Requirement Operating system Ubuntu 22.04 / 24.04, x86_64 Python Python 3.10 in the Conda environment Environment manager Conda Privileges sudo is needed for installation and networking Internet Required for packages and source repositories Main dependencies OpenPLC command-line runtime, ns-3, DHALSIM-epynet Important: The installer builds the OpenPLC command-line runtime, not the full web management service. Clone the repository git clone https://github.com/WandeF/hydro-cps-sim.git cd hydro-cps-sim Preview installation steps bash install.sh --dry-run Install After checking the required privileges and system compatibility: bash install.sh conda activate hydro-cps Building ns-3 and OpenPLC may take some time. The default environment is named hydro-cps ; see bash install.sh --help for --env , --jobs , and --parent options. Run the project test suite python -m unittest discover -s tests Successful documentation generation does not establish successful installation of the simulation runtime. The runtime must be tested separately on a compatible Linux machine. Source review: hydro-cps-sim @ 2406aa6 · 2026-10-15. The installer rewrites five top-level path keys in every C-Town YAML and saves changed originals under output/install-backups/ . Check paths after moving to a different machine; do not reuse developer-specific absolute paths from the source.

title: Quick Start
description: Quick Start This guide uses the project's C-Town example as an entry point. The commands follow the currently published run script and assume a s
text: Quick Start This guide uses the project's C-Town example as an entry point. The commands follow the currently published run script and assume a successful installation. Each run clears runtime/ , reports/ , st/ , and plcs/ under the configured output directory. Copy results to a separate directory before the next experiment. Start as a normal user; the script requests sudo when needed. Run a simulation cd hydro-cps-sim conda activate hydro-cps bash scripts/run_all.sh --logic-wait 0.3 You may override the configured number of iterations to try a shorter run: bash scripts/run_all.sh --iterations 10 --logic-wait 0.3 The value 10 is illustrative, not a validated benchmark configuration. Select a configuration bash scripts/run_all.sh --config examples/c_town/config.yaml Option Purpose --config PATH YAML configuration file --iterations N Number of iterations --logic-wait SECONDS Wait after SCADA downlink before reading control outputs --poll-interval SECONDS Marker polling interval --scada-modbus-workers N Concurrent SCADA Modbus workers Run bash scripts/run_all.sh --help for the definitive interface. Outputs According to the runner, the exported CSV files are located under the configured output directory in reports/csv . At completion, the script prints a message resembling: [DONE] Results: <output_path>/reports/csv The actual path comes from output_path in the configuration. The placeholder above is not a literal path. Continue with experiments and configuration . Source review: hydro-cps-sim @ 2406aa6 · 2026-10-15.

title: Experiments
description: Security Experiments A core research goal is to trace how cyber events propagate through communication → information freshness/integrity → contro
text: Security Experiments A core research goal is to trace how cyber events propagate through communication → information freshness/integrity → controller decisions → hydraulic behavior . Research scenarios Scenario Primary disturbance Evidence of interest Man-in-the-Middle (MITM) Altered communication values Input corruption, PLC decisions, physical deviations Denial of Service (DoS) Delay, packet loss, or timeout Data freshness, cached values, control timing PLC logic manipulation Modified control rules Logic integrity, actuator outputs, physical trajectories Published configuration files The table reflects actual YAML contents. Windows are control iterations. These presets were reviewed in source but were not executed as full simulations for this website. Configuration Target or purpose Attack iterations config.yaml 无攻击基线 / Baseline — config_mitm_plc4.yaml PLC4 下发 / Downlink 20–40 config_mitm_plc9.yaml PLC8 T7 响应 / Response 20–40 config_mitm_composite_plc7_plc9.yaml PLC6 T5 + PLC8 T7 20–40 / 30–50 config_dos_plc2_single.yaml PLC2 · 单源 / Single source 5–90 config_dos_plc2_three_bots.yaml PLC2 · 三源 / Three sources 5–90 config_openplc_logic_plc4.yaml PLC4 · PU10 T7 阈值 / Threshold 20–90 PLC7/PLC9 in filenames are historical names; the current targets are PLC6/PLC8 as defined by YAML. The older README_attack_mitm.md refers to missing config_mitm.yaml and scripts/compare_attack_results.py . After installation, select an existing configuration in the simulation environment (source-checked command, not executed during this deployment): bash scripts/run_all.sh --config examples/c_town/config_mitm_plc4.yaml --logic-wait 0.3 Run and preserve a baseline before the attack run. Exports under reports/csv/ include physics.csv , actuator_state.csv , scada_observed_long.csv , scada_observed_wide.csv , scada_observed_key.csv , attack_schedule.csv , attack_events.csv , scada_timeout_events.csv , and cycle_timing.csv . Attack events or timeouts alone do not establish physical deviation; compare aligned baseline evidence. Suggested methodology Fix hydraulic scenarios, control programs, time horizon, and random settings where applicable. Record attack-free baseline results including CSV files and runtime logs. Change only the attack variables under evaluation. Align network-level, control-level, and hydraulic observations. Analyze repeated runs, not just a single simulation trace. Why cross-layer evidence matters The same tank-level deviation could reflect false sensor values, a stale observation after a timeout, or an unauthorized PLC logic change. Evidence from upstream layers is essential for attribution. In a DoS scenario, communication failure alone does not guarantee a control deviation; propagation depends in part on whether fresh data is required at the relevant control iteration. Documentation to add before release Runnable attack configurations and a field-by-field reference. Validated commands for both baseline and attack scenarios. Output-directory conventions and metric definitions. Reproducible plots, seeds, and versioned configurations. Experimental results and publication claims should be added only after verification and paper finalization. Source review: hydro-cps-sim @ 2406aa6 · 2026-10-15.

title: Configuration
description: Configuration The published runner accepts a YAML file and defaults to examples/c_town/config.yaml . What configuration controls Input hydraulic
text: Configuration The published runner accepts a YAML file and defaults to examples/c_town/config.yaml . What configuration controls Input hydraulic network files and simulation settings. External paths for OpenPLC and ns-3. Output directories and run length. Network, control, and experiment settings. The installer explicitly processes several top-level path keys: Key Purpose root_path Working directory for external dependencies openplc_path OpenPLC checkout or build directory ns3_path ns-3 checkout or build directory inp_file EPANET input file output_path Directory for generated results These keys can be verified against install.sh . Other keys have deliberately been left for a future source-verified reference. Recommended practice Keep the original validated baseline configuration intact. Make copies for new experiments and record the git commit, exact YAML, invocation, and outputs for each run. To be completed Full field reference grouped by subsystem. Verified baseline and attack YAML examples. Mapping rules connecting network topology, PLC signals, and hydraulic elements. Source review: hydro-cps-sim @ 2406aa6 · 2026-10-15. Additional source-checked fields Field Baseline value or role iterations 100; runner can override noise_scale 0.0 time EPANET duration 86400 seconds; hydraulic step 300 seconds physics inp_controls: strip , step_order: next-run , init_flag: 0 plcs Sensors, actuators and control rules for PLC1–PLC8 network ns-3 backend, realtime scheduling, routing, nodes, links, LANs and TAPs attacks.enabled Global switch in attack presets attacks.scenarios Scenario types, triggers, targets and type-specific options Published types include modbus_mitm , udp_dos , and openplc_logic_injection . An iteration_window trigger uses start_iteration and end_iteration . Scenarios also need matching network endpoints, interception rules or logic injection settings; adding only a switch to the baseline is insufficient. See actual presets under experiments .

title: Contributing
description: Contributing & Feedback Suggestions on functionality, installation, and reproducibility are welcome. A formal contribution policy and the open-so
text: Contributing & Feedback Suggestions on functionality, installation, and reproducibility are welcome. A formal contribution policy and the open-source license will be established as the release plan is finalized. Reporting a problem Please use the project's GitHub Issues and include: OS and Python / Conda versions. Git commit and sanitized configuration files. Reproduction commands and relevant errors. Expected and actual results. Updating the website The website is intentionally separated from the simulator repository. Edit Markdown pages under content/zh/ and content/en/ , then run: python build.py Generated files are written to site/ . Preview locally with python -m http.server 8000 --directory site . Push to main in WandeF/WandeF.github.io to build and deploy automatically to https://wandef.github.io/ . Before an official public release Consider adding LICENSE , CONTRIBUTING.md , version-management guidance, and a responsible security disclosure process.
